summary: Iteration 4 RETEST of GYMBOSS_VVO. Backend: 114/114 pytest passed (105 existing + 9 new targeted fix-verification tests in test_retest_iter4.py). All 10 claimed fixes were verified; 9 fully pass, 2 are partial/incomplete. I additionally PROVED the seed migration works on a genuinely legacy DB (scripted an unset of plans.type + upper-cased staff.role, restarted backend, and the startup migration repaired both, after which all 9 fix tests passed). Frontend spot-checks on the public URL: demo login, Add Member plan dropdown (4 plans), DateField shadcn Calendar popovers (member-form-dob + freeze-from, dd MMM yyyy), filtered-empty states on Members/Payments/Enquiries, Payments Record Payment -> receipt modal, staff role capitalization, attendance history + reports tabs, finance, announcements, super admin console. Console is clean of DialogTitle errors, but ONE duplicate-React-key error remains and it exposed a real backend data-integrity bug: next_member_code() generates member codes that collide with the demo gym's seeded codes.

critical.issue: DUPLICATE member_code. seed_demo() writes members with hardcoded codes IPF-1001..IPF-1026 but never initialises db.counters['member:<org_id>']. next_member_code() therefore restarts from IPF-1001 and every member created through the UI/API in the demo gym gets a code that already belongs to a seeded member. Reproduced live: new member 'TEST_QA Iter4' was assigned IPF-1017, already held by 'Harsh Vardhan' (verified by mongo aggregate). Consequences: (a) GET /api/reports/membership-expiry returned the same member_code twice -> the React duplicate-key console error still fires on Reports; (b) members.py:432 does find_one({'$or':[...{'member_code': rx}]}) for the receipt/announcement member lookup, so a code lookup can silently resolve to the WRONG member; (c) search by member ID returns 2 rows. Fix: seed_demo must upsert db.counters to len(seeded_members); add a startup migration that bumps each org's member+receipt counter above the max existing code; add a unique index on (organisation_id, member_code) so collisions fail loudly.

minor.issue: The migration correctly backfills type='membership' from the legacy category, but the already-seeded demo org still has ONLY the 4 legacy membership plans - the Milestone-2 pt/service/product seed rows (PT - 12 Sessions, Steam & Sauna, Whey Protein 1kg) were never added because seed_demo() early-returns. Plans & Catalogue PT/Service/Product tabs are therefore empty for the demo account. Consider making the migration also insert the missing catalogue rows.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate-key fix is INCOMPLETE. rowKey="member_code" is not a unique key: console still logs 'Encountered two children with the same key, IPF-1017' on the Reports page. Use the member id (or fall back to an index) as the React key. Attendance history rowKey="date" is fine - no warning observed.

Receipt-modal parity is the wrong way round. /app/payments now DOES open the receipt after a successful payment (fix verified, receipt-amount=Rs.100). But MemberDrawer.doPay (MemberDrawer.jsx:112-122) only toasts and never calls setReceipt, so the drawer flow still shows no receipt (verified twice: payment posted, due dropped 1000->800->750, [data-testid="receipt-modal"] never rendered). doRenew has the same gap.

issues: 'Freeze Until' DateField now starts empty, so the first submit always fails with the 'Select freeze-until date' toast. Not a defect (validation works) but prefilling +30 days or marking the field required would be friendlier.

action_items: HIGH: fix duplicate member_code generation - initialise db.counters in seed_demo(), add a startup migration bumping counters past the max existing member_code/receipt_no, and add a unique index on (organisation_id, member_code).
MEDIUM: change the Reports expiry/dues DataTable rowKey from member_code to the member id - the duplicate React key error is still in the console.
LOW: call the receipt endpoint + setReceipt in MemberDrawer.doPay and doRenew for real parity with /app/payments.
LOW: extend the startup migration (or seed) to add the missing pt/service/product catalogue rows for already-seeded demo orgs so those Plans tabs are not empty.
LOW: prefill Freeze Until (e.g. freeze-from + 30d) so the freeze modal does not fail on first submit.
critical_code_review_comments: deps.next_member_code(): a counter document that is not seeded alongside hardcoded seed data guarantees collisions. Codes are user-facing identifiers used for lookup (members.py:432) - they must be enforced unique at the DB level, not just generated optimistically.

ui.jsx DataTable: rowKey defaults to 'id' which is safe; passing a business field (member_code) as rowKey re-introduces key collisions whenever that field is not unique. Prefer id and only override when the row genuinely has no id (e.g. rowKey='date' for the aggregated attendance rows).

server.py startup migration (lines ~673-674) is the right pattern and verified working: plans.update_many with $ifNull category->type and staff role $toLower both repaired a scripted legacy DB after restart. Keep this idempotent block and add the member-counter migration to it.
members.py list_plans() defensive $or fallback ({'type': t} OR {'type' missing, 'category': t}) verified present - good belt-and-braces alongside the migration.

MemberDrawer.jsx is large and duplicates payment/renew/freeze modal logic that also exists in Payments.jsx; extracting a shared usePayment hook would remove the parity drift that caused the receipt-modal inconsistency.

rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate member_code RCA: seed_demo() (server.py:526,569) inserts 26 demo members with literal codes f'IPF-{1001+i}' but never touches db.counters. deps.next_member_code() derives codes from find_one_and_update({'_id': 'member:<org>'}, {'$inc': {'seq': 1}}, upsert=True) which therefore starts at seq=1 -> IPF-1001, walking straight through the seeded range. db.counters currently shows seq=17 for the demo org, so the next ~9 members created will each duplicate a seeded code. Verified by mongo aggregate ({o, c} group, n>1) which returned IPF-1017 shared by 'Harsh Vardhan' and my UI-created member, and by GET /api/reports/membership-expiry returning member_code IPF-1017 twice - which is exactly the source of the surviving React duplicate-key console error (rowKey='member_code'). Mitigation applied for testing: deleted the TEST_ member so no duplicates remain right now; the code path is unfixed. Permanent fix: seed the counter, add a startup migration to raise counters above max existing codes, and add a unique compound index.
